<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflict and attacks
*A [[suicide bomber]] driving a [[Humvee]] detonated the vehicle loaded with explosives near a security building in [[Afghanistan]], killing 8 officers. [https://ariananews.af/8-killed-7-injured-as-car-bomb-hits-security-base-in-ghazni/ (ariananews)]
;Arts and culture
*[[Pope Francis]] visits [[Romania]], meeting with [[Patriarch Daniel of Romania|Patriarch Daniel]] of the [[Romanian Orthodox Church]] and holding an open [[Mass in the Catholic Church|mass]] in front of 80,000 people. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/06/01/world/europe/pope-francis-romania.html (''The New York Times'')]
** Pope Francis urges ethnic [[Hungarians in Romania|Hungarians]] and Romanians to mend their differences toward a peaceful existence in one country. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pope-romania/pope-urges-ethnic-hungarians-romanians-to-put-troubles-behind-them-idUSKCN1T2306 (Reuters)]

;Business and economics
*[[China|Chinese]] authorities begin an investigation into [[United States|American]] multinational courier delivery services company [[FedEx]] for allegedly undermining the rights of Chinese clients. The investigation stems from allegations by Chinese telecommunications company Huawei that FedEx attempted to divert the shipping route of its packages without the company's prior authorization which in turn has been denied by FedEx. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/06/01/beijing-to-investigate-fedex-for-damaging-rights-of-chinese-clients-amid-huawei-dispute.html (CNBC)] 

;Disasters and accidents
*Twenty-nine people are injured in a fire  at a center used as temporary accommodation for about 500 migrants in the northwestern [[Bosnia]]n town of [[Velika Kladusa]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-bosnia/fire-at-migrant-center-in-bosnia-injures-29-police-idUSKCN1T230E?il=0 (Reuters)]
*An explosion at a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian Military]] high-explosive production and storage facility in the city of [[Dzerzhinsk, Russia|Dzerzhinsk]] injures 79 people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48484682 (BBC News)]
* Six earthquakes, the first 5.3 {{M|w|link=y}}, in a two-hour period near [[Korçë]] in southeastern [[Albania]] injure four people and damage around 100 houses. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-albania-quake/quakes-in-albania-damage-100-homes-four-injured-idUSKCN1T22ZS?il=0z (Reuters)]
* Cruise ship [[MSC Opera|MSC ''Opera'']] collides with a riverboat and the quayside at [[Venice]], Italy: four people are injured, none seriously. The incident leads to renewed demands to ban large cruise ships from the [[Venetian Lagoon|Lagoon of Venice]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48489158 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[Hong Kong]] confirms its second case of [[African swine fever virus|African swine fever]], indicating the virus continues to spread beyond mainland China. [[Sheung Shui]] slaughterhouse is temporarily closed while 4,100 animals are culled from the facility. [https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/hong-kong-economy/article/3012715/african-swine-fever-returns-hong-kong-hitting (''South China Morning Post'')]

;International relations
*[[Honduras–United States relations]], [[2017–2019 Honduran protests]]
**Dozens of masked protesters set fire to the [[United States|U.S.]] Embassy in downtown [[Tegucigalpa]], amid a second day of mass anti-government protests in [[Honduras]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-honduras-protests/protesters-set-fire-to-us-embassy-in-honduras-in-second-day-of-demonstrations-idUSKCN1T12PQ (Reuters)]
*At the close of the [[Organization of Islamic Cooperation]] summit in [[Mecca]], the OIC says it will not accept any decision to change the legal and demographic status of Syria's [[Golan Heights]], that it condemns any position adopted by an international body that supports prolonging occupation of [[Palestinian territories]], and it condemns the inhumane situation of [[Rohingya Muslims]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-summit-oic-golan/oic-refuses-to-accept-any-decision-to-change-legal-status-of-syrias-golan-heights-idUSKCN1T22VE?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-summit-palestinians-oic/oic-summit-condemns-any-decision-to-recognize-jerusalem-as-israels-capital-idUSKCN1T22UY?il=0 (Reuters²)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-summit-oic-rohingya/oic-condemns-inhumane-situation-of-myanmars-rohingya-idUSKCN1T22VG?il=0 (Reuters³)]
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**The United States begins collecting the higher, 25 percent [[tariff]]s on many Chinese goods arriving in U.S. seaports. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china-tariffs/u-s-begins-collecting-higher-tariffs-on-chinese-goods-arriving-by-sea-idUKKCN1T22W7 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Indictment and arrest of Julian Assange]]
**The [[United Nations]] special rapporteur on torture, [[Nils Melzer]], accuses the [[United States]], the [[United Kingdom]] and [[Sweden]] of "ganging up" on [[Julian Assange]] and subjecting him to "psychological torture" and "collective persecution" after spending seven years living inside [[Embassy of Ecuador, London|London's Ecuadorian Embassy]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/31/world/europe/julian-assange-torture-un.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States presidential election]]
**[[Governor of Maryland|Maryland Governor]] [[Larry Hogan]] says he won't challenge [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] for the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party's]] nomination for President in the 2020 presidential election, leaving [[Bill Weld]] as the only other major candidate for the nomination. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/06/01/maryland-gov-larry-hogan-wont-challenge-trump-for-2020-gop-presidential-nomination.html (CNBC)]
*[[2018-2019 Sudanese protests|Sudanese protests]]
**Shots fired by "regular forces" near the site of a sit-in protest in [[Khartoum]] kill one person and wound 10 others, according to the  Central Committee of [[Sudan]]ese Doctors. The  gunfire lasted about four hours. This week  at least three protesters have been shot dead and eight others injured during protests calling for the generals who replaced deposed  President [[Omar al-Bashir]] to hand power to a civilian-led administration. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sudan-politics/eleven-wounded-in-sudan-by-gunfire-near-sit-in-opposition-committee-idUSKCN1T23GJ?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/sudan-forces-fired-gunshots-disperse-sit-witnesses-190601172719030.html (Al Jazeera)]
*El Salvador's new President [[Nayib Bukele]] takes office. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-elsalvador-politics/new-president-pledges-to-cure-sick-child-el-salvador-idUSKCN1T23FH?il=0 (Reuters)] 
*The website ''[[The Daily Beast]]'' identifies the man who posted a video of [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|U.S. House Speaker]] [[Nancy Pelosi]] in order to create the misleading impression of drunkenly slurred speech. It was "an occasional sports blogger from the Bronx." [https://www.thedailybeast.com/we-found-shawn-brooks-the-guy-behind-the-viral-drunk-pelosi-video (''The Daily Beast'')].

;Sports
*[[Liverpool F.C.]] defeats [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.]] by a score of 2–0 to win the [[2019 UEFA Champions League Final]]. [https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/liverpool-vs-tottenham-champions-league-final-score-salah-delivers-after-controversial-penalty-as-reds-win-ucl/ (CBS Sports)]
*[[Andy Ruiz Jr.]] defeats [[Anthony Joshua]] by knockout in the seventh round to become IBF, WBA and WBO heavyweight champion of the world in what has been described as one of the biggest upsets in heavyweight boxing history. [https://news.sky.com/story/massive-shock-as-anthony-joshua-loses-heavyweight-titles-to-underdog-andy-ruiz-jr-11733281 (Sky News)]
